risks.risk: Brand mismatch: seller says Canon but photo shows Nikon; could be wrong item or bait-and-switch.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera front/top showing the exact brand and model name (e.g., 'Canon EOS ...' or 'Nikon D...') plus the lens markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used DSLR kit with uncertain model/condition (worst case within the provided comparables).

risks.risk: Exact camera model is unreadable; price varies a lot by model (e.g., D3300 vs D90 vs T6i).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the model name on the camera body (and the lens focal length markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable that still matches 'DSLR with 18-55 lens' category, treating it as older/less desirable.

risks.risk: Second lens may not be the claimed 50mm (could be another focal length or a non-matching lens).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both lenses showing the printed focal length (e.g., '18-55mm' and '50mm') and mount compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if only the 18-55 lens is confirmed; treat the second lens as not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (shutter, autofocus, video, buttons, battery/charger, memory card).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip: camera powered on, autofocus on a moving subject, and 10–20 seconds of video recording + playback.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume worst-case: needs testing (i.e., not priced as 'fully working').

proof_requests: Send a clear photo showing the exact camera brand and model name on the body (not just the lens).
Send close-up photos of both lenses with the printed focal length markings (confirm 18-55mm and 50mm).
Send a short powered-on test video: record 10–20 seconds and play it back (show autofocus working).
Send photos of included items: battery, charger, and any memory card (if included).
response.reason: Photo 0 contradicts the seller’s Canon claim (it shows Nikon), and the exact camera model plus the second lens focal length are not readable. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently from the comparables.
